Phase 8 – Memory & Contextual Data Persistence
Objective

Retain multi-turn memory of user interactions.

Track pilot progress, service history, and open questions.

Enable personalized suggestions, proactive upsells, and context-aware responses.

Ensure long-term engagement with consistent brand voice.

Memory Architecture
1. User Profile Memory

Stores basic info for personalization:

{
  "user_id": "unique_user_id",
  "name": "John Doe",
  "company": "Acme Inc.",
  "industry": "Real Estate",
  "preferred_services": ["CGI Ads", "AI Automation"],
  "timezone": "UTC+0"
}

2. Conversation History Memory

Keeps multi-turn chat context:

{
  "session_id": "neon_session_001",
  "last_active": "2026-01-21T10:15:00Z",
  "messages": [
    {"role": "user", "message": "Tell me about your pilot program"},
    {"role": "ai", "message": "The CGI & Performance Ads Pilot is a 14–21 day campaign..."},
    {"role": "user", "message": "What are the pricing tiers?"}
  ],
